title: Silver.Horizon.Repair.Unvouched.Split.2024.720p.WEB.x264-WEAVER
description: The same six-volume PPMd .7z and the same damaged fifth volume as direct-unpack-repair, but with 16 KiB parity slices that the default article size straddles. No article lies wholly inside a block, so no block closes, no in-stream grid exists, and nothing gates the chase. The recovery set's block verdicts vouch for precisely nothing, which leaves the PAR2 analysis pass's file-level verdicts as the only evidence the repair decision can act on — and on that alone the chase must park through the repair and resume over the rewritten volume rather than be discarded.
